scope: Price change from ₪450 to ₪375 across the whole site, commit d28ac8d on master, decided by Eytan. Package structure unchanged: still one package "הסרטון שלכם", 10-15 seconds, minimal pre-payment form (groom_name, bride_name, email, phone). Updated: the pricing card, the radio value string sent to Formspree, PACKAGE_PRICES.regular, and the Purchase pixel value so Meta reports 375 rather than 450 as revenue. A legacy order already stored in localStorage with price 450 deliberately still reports 450, because that customer was actually charged 450. All asset cache tags bumped to ?v=20260802a. The Grow payment page amount was separately changed to 375 in the Grow dashboard and verified at three layers before this deploy, so the site price and the charged amount match.
automated_coverage_details: node --check all JS clean; zero '450' in any user-facing text across index/thank-you/terms/photos both viewports; all 7 asset refs on ?v=20260802a; no em dashes in rendered text
browser_test_details: Playwright clean-browser desktop+mobile, all outbound stubbed: 0 console errors; card shows 375; radio value and Formspree payload carry 375; PACKAGE_PRICES.regular=375; sd_pending_order.price=375; Purchase pixel fires {value:375,currency:ILS}; legacy order seeded with price 450 correctly still fires 450; phone validation blocks; full pixel funnel each exactly once; Lead per-order guarded; delivery #2 full identity, one gallery link; degraded path unique subject; total Formspree per lifecycle = 2
known_flags: Dead 2-tier CSS remains in style.css (.tier-toggle-btn.vip, .pricing-card.pricing-vip at lines 686, 690, 1334, 1340, 1342, 2199); classes appear nowhere in HTML or JS, cosmetic only. If Grow returns without paid=1, sd_pending_order is not cleared (order-flow.js:255) so the customer may see a "complete your payment" banner for an order they already paid. The Lead pixel deliberately does not fire when no order id can be resolved (cleared storage or private browsing), consistent with Purchase. The gap between the AddPaymentInfo pixel call and the redirect is roughly 1 to 2 milliseconds (order-flow.js:176 then :179); measured safe for real visitors above 120ms of navigation latency, but it is a fragile point worth hardening later. Pixel statistics for 2026-08-02 are contaminated by 8 real QA submissions that fired InitiateCheckout and AddPaymentInfo against the live pixel; Meta's attributed numbers are unaffected, but raw pixel stats for that date must be discounted.
